supplier_item_ids_status: The current batch-4 A-page manifest now lists these seven IDs. The relevant remainder carrier thm-lagrange-interpolation-remainder exists as a draft; its body was inspected, but no readiness or acceptance is claimed.
required_interface: The relevant carrier thm-lagrange-interpolation-remainder states: n is a natural number with n>=0; a<b; x_0<...<x_n are distinct nodes in [a,b]; f is C^(n+1)[a,b]; and x is in [a,b]. At a node the interpolation error is zero; otherwise there is xi in (min{x,x_0}, max{x,x_n}) with f(x)-I_n f(x)=f^(n+1)(xi) omega_n(x)/(n+1)!_R.

Its proof interface uses the cardinal polynomial definition, existence and uniqueness of the interpolant, C^(n+1) regularity, higher-order Rolle, the highest-derivative formula for a polynomial, derivative linearity, polynomial continuity, and the canonical natural embedding.
